Quantum X Labs has launched an end‑to‑end quantum error‑correction program at the Israeli Quantum Computing Center, which is operated by Quantum Machines. The initiative aims to develop robust quantum processors through integrated hardware and firmware solutions. This development was reported by *The Manila Times* and aggregated in global news feeds via Google News.
